name.full: IQ Bridge - Work IQ and Foundry IQ agent

description.short: Answers from your Microsoft 365 work data and a Foundry IQ knowledge base
description.full: IQ Bridge is a declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot that answers questions from two knowledge systems: Work IQ, the intelligence layer over your Microsoft 365 work data (emails, Teams messages, SharePoint and OneDrive documents, and people), and Foundry IQ, a knowledge base hosted in Azure AI Search that can live in a different Microsoft Entra directory than your Microsoft 365 Copilot tenant.
